summary.text: Susan Porcelli is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 19 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Susan Porcelli's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2022, succeeding Patrick Abrami (R) in the Rockingham 19 seat.
